    • resolveOuterClass

      public @NonNull Optional<? extends ClassType> resolveOuterClass()
      Resolves the outer class from the system annotations of the dex file, like Soot's dex frontend: EnclosingClass names the outer class of a member class, EnclosingMethod the method that declares a local or anonymous class. If only an InnerClass annotation exists, the outer class is derived from the name of the class.
